$comment: Dispatch ceiling for the research lane — the maximum number of event-research sessions `scripts/event-scan.mjs --due` will hand the moneypenny-events.yml matrix on a single tick. This is a POLICY CEILING, not a debt budget: it has no `--update` ratchet, deliberately. The house ratchet idiom (dead-budget.json et al, `Math.min(prev, debt)`) is right for debt that should only ever shrink; auto-ratcheting a dispatch ceiling would pin it to whatever a quiet day happened to produce and eventually to 0, silently stopping all research. Same reasoning that moved arch-scan off a numbered ratchet onto arch-grandfather.json. Raise or lower maxPerTick by editing this file — one line, reviewed like any other policy change. Context: issue #2946; authorized as conserve-mode by Eric 2026-09-15 per docs/COMPUTE.md.
$why: The lane burned a full weekly token limit in ~24h. At the moment this landed, `--due` returned 108 events — 108 opus sessions at --max-turns 150, armed to dispatch on the next merge to main. Every pre-existing control bounded the wrong axis: max-parallel is concurrency, --max-turns is one session, dueForResearch() is a dedupe. Nothing bounded COUNT. 6 is sized so a single tick can never again open a burst that outruns a weekly quota; the deferred remainder is not dropped, it is simply picked up on later ticks in priority order.
